name: Error: Human Not Found
source:
Error: Human Not Found places the player in the role of Grace Fortran, a computer scientist stationed on-board the Noah Sphere, a research station in space. Instead of celebrating the success of the first Artificial Intelligence (AI) being uploaded to a physical android, Grace is racing to clear her name in the death of the AI who was found dead less than 24 hours after the upload. Work together with another AI, Ada, to search for clues, question suspects, and solve four kinds of computer-science related puzzles in this science-fiction visual-novel/puzzle game hybrid. Determine the fate of AI's and their relationship with humanity with three endings to this murder mystery. Unlock databases that give background information about the real-life computer scientists, mathematicians, and roboticist that the characters share names with. 

[From [url=http://www.cellecgames.com/error-human-not-found/]Official website[/url]]
translation:
《错误：找不到人类》让玩家扮演格蕾丝·福特兰 (Grace Fortran) 的角色，她是一名驻扎在太空研究站诺亚球体上的计算机科学家。格蕾丝没有庆祝第一个人工智能 (AI) 成功上传到实体机器人，而是竞相为人工智能的死亡洗清罪名，上传后不到24小时，人工智能就被发现死亡。在这款科幻视觉小说/益智游戏混合体中，与另一个人工智能Ada合作，寻找线索、询问嫌疑人并解决四种与计算机科学相关的谜题。通过这个谋杀之谜的三个结局来决定人工智能的命运以及他们与人类的关系。解锁数据库，提供与角色同名的现实计算机科学家、数学家和机器人专家的背景信息。

【来自[url=http://www.cellecgames.com/error-human-not-found/]官网[/url]】
